title: Engine Driven Pump — Installation

issue.reason: Original issue of the engine driven pump installation task.

abstract: Installation of an engine driven pump on the accessory gearbox, with the spline lubrication, the single case drain union torque, the bleed sequence and the full pressure leak check.

sections.purpose: This task gives the installation of one engine driven pump on the accessory gearbox, the system bleed and the leak check at full system pressure.
sections.job_setup_note: The gearbox pad and the drive spline must be clean and the spline lubricant must be the grade named in the task; a different grade shortens the spline life sharply. The case drain is a single continuous run from the pump to the reservoir return and is torqued as one joint. The hydraulic bleed rig is needed and the system must be bled before the first pressurisation.
sections.procedure: 1. WARNING: MAKE SURE THAT THE ENGINE CANNOT BE ROTATED WHILE A PERSON IS AT THE ACCESSORY GEARBOX. 2. Clean the gearbox pad and examine the pad face for damage. 3. Apply the named spline lubricant to the drive spline in the quantity given in the task. 4. CAUTION: DO NOT USE A SUBSTITUTE SPLINE LUBRICANT. A DIFFERENT GRADE CAUSES RAPID SPLINE WEAR. 5. Offer the pump squarely to the pad and engage the spline without force. 6. Install the pump retaining nuts and torque them in the diagonal sequence given in the task. 7. Connect the pressure line and torque the union. 8. Connect the case drain return pipe D2910004303006 at the isolation valve D2910110251872 and torque the union to the single value given in the task. 9. Install the anchor nuts AES818405K5 at the valve bracket and check the clearance to the non-return valve 469GG. 10. Refit the clamp 280GG8 on the harness run. 11. Bleed the hydraulic system with the bleed rig in the sequence given in the task. 12. Pressurise to full system pressure, do the leak check and hold for fifteen minutes, then do the pump operational check.
sections.close_out: Make sure that there is no external leak after the fifteen minute hold and that the reservoir level is correct after bleeding. Install the pylon lower access panel and close the fan cowl doors. Record the installed pump serial number, the spline lubricant batch, the torque values and the leak check result in the aircraft technical record.

safety_precautions: Make sure that the engine cannot be rotated while a person is at the accessory gearbox.
Put the fan cowl doors on their stays.
Use eye protection during the pressurised leak check.

title: Engine Driven Pump — Installation

issue.reason: Case drain re-written as two joints with a valve orientation check and a flow direction marking call-out on aircraft at the relief valve standard.

abstract: Installation of an engine driven pump on the accessory gearbox, with the spline lubrication, the two-joint case drain sequence and orientation check at the relief valve standard, the bleed sequence and the full pressure leak check.

sections.purpose: This task gives the installation of one engine driven pump on the accessory gearbox, the system bleed and the leak check at full system pressure.
sections.job_setup_note: The gearbox pad and the drive spline must be clean and the spline lubricant must be the grade named in the task; a different grade shortens the spline life sharply. Establish the case drain standard before the pipes are offered up. On an aircraft at the anti-cavitation relief valve standard the case drain is not one run but two joints with the valve between them, and the valve is directional: the etched arrow on its body points towards the reservoir return. A valve fitted the other way round passes every ground check, because at ground flow it simply stays open, and it fails only on the first rapid thrust reduction in service, which is the event the valve exists for. The hydraulic bleed rig is needed and the system must be bled before the first pressurisation.
sections.procedure: 1. WARNING: MAKE SURE THAT THE ENGINE CANNOT BE ROTATED WHILE A PERSON IS AT THE ACCESSORY GEARBOX. 2. Clean the gearbox pad and examine the pad face for damage. 3. Apply the named spline lubricant to the drive spline in the quantity given in the task. 4. CAUTION: DO NOT USE A SUBSTITUTE SPLINE LUBRICANT. A DIFFERENT GRADE CAUSES RAPID SPLINE WEAR. 5. Offer the pump squarely to the pad and engage the spline without force. 6. Install the pump retaining nuts and torque them in the diagonal sequence given in the task. 7. Connect the pressure line and torque the union. 8. On an aircraft at the earlier standard, connect the case drain return pipe D2910004303006 at the isolation valve D2910110251872 and torque the union to the single value given in the task, then go to step 12. 9. CAUTION: AT THE RELIEF VALVE STANDARD, CHECK THE DIRECTION ARROW ON THE VALVE BODY BEFORE EITHER UNION IS TIGHTENED. THE ARROW POINTS TOWARDS THE RESERVOIR RETURN. 10. Connect the pump side joint to the second port of the isolation valve D2910110251872 and torque it to the pump side value, which is the lower of the two. 11. Connect the return side joint of the return pipe D2910004303006 to the valve outlet, torque it to the return side value, and confirm the direction arrow is still visible and correctly oriented with both unions tight. 12. Install the anchor nuts AES818405K5 at the valve bracket and check the clearance to the non-return valve 469GG. 13. Refit the clamp 280GG8 on the harness run. 14. Bleed the hydraulic system with the bleed rig in the sequence given in the task. 15. Pressurise to full system pressure, do the leak check and hold for fifteen minutes, then do the pump operational check.
sections.close_out: Make sure that there is no external leak after the fifteen minute hold and that the reservoir level is correct after bleeding. At the relief valve standard, confirm once more with the panel off that the direction arrow on the valve body points towards the reservoir return, and record that confirmation by name. Install the pylon lower access panel and close the fan cowl doors. Record the installed pump serial number, the spline lubricant batch, both case drain torque values and the leak check result in the aircraft technical record.

type_data.effectivity_note: All aircraft. On aircraft at the anti-cavitation relief valve standard the case drain has two joints with separate torque values and the valve orientation must be confirmed twice, once before the unions are tightened and once at close-out.

safety_precautions: Make sure that the engine cannot be rotated while a person is at the accessory gearbox.
Put the fan cowl doors on their stays.
Use eye protection during the pressurised leak check.
